svg.text: Listed → Viewed → Negotiation → Sold (or direct Listed → Sold on instant buy)
Created → Queued → Sent → Read | Sent → Failed → retry → Sent
Guard conditions shown on transitions. Dashed red = admin or error path. All states persisted in PostgreSQL.
Notification worker polls queue async — user request returns immediately; state changes happen in background.
NegotiationRequest.status field drives the state: pending | accepted | rejected | completed.
User.verified (bool) + User.is_active (bool) + User.is_suspended (bool) together model the four user states.
